name: FLEURS: Few-shot Learning Evaluation of Universal Representations of Speech
description: FLEURS is an evaluation benchmark for multi-lingual and few-shot speech recognition covering 102 languages. An extension of the FLoRes machine translation benchmark, it contains approximately 12 hours of supervised high-quality speech per language for multi-task evaluation including ASR, Speech Translation, and Language Identification.
